image_description: A close-up macro photograph of a brown butterfly, identified as a ringlet, perched on green vegetation. The butterfly's wings are held closed, displaying a uniform dark brown color with faint rows of small eyespots (ocelli) along the margins. The body is fuzzy and brown, matching the wings. One antenna is clearly visible with a clubbed tip, while the other is partially obscured or angled away. Several legs are visible gripping the plant stem.
